detail.longDescription: If I make a collection of docker compose or podman container files available in a public git repository, what would be the proper license, if any? The individual files would be the official/recommended files, with a few modifications and comments of my own. Next step could be adding an ansible playbook to deploy the containers, but I'm not quite there yet. I'm not claiming that I wrote the files from scratch, it's more about making my setup notes available to the public, and my future self. # docker # podman # git # license
